subject: Partner dock/sidecar load plan + ambient audio permit (Aurum)
messages:
From: Aurum Events <ops@aurumevents.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: SoundRentals Ltd. <scheduling@soundrentals.co>, ACME Sponsorships <sponsorships@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Site sharing request: dock sidecar access + ambient audio note

Hi team —

Hope you’re well. Venue ops here at Aurum. We’re finalizing dock assignments for Hall B (load-in window Dec 6–8) and there’s a potential sidecar share required between Redwood and ACME (next-door sponsor). We need to confirm:

- Whether Redwood is comfortable with a shared sidecar (12ft) during the 2–4pm load slot on Day 1 (Dec 6).
- If Redwood plans to run ambient audio (booth-level background music or demos). Venue requires a brief permit + decibel cap sign-off for any amplified audio.

Attached: dock_map_v3.pdf (shows sidecar area), sidecar_loadlist_v2.csv (initial load items).

Requests: can you confirm by EOD Monday (Dec 13) so we can lock the dock schedule and submit the audio permit? If there’s any loadlist changes, please update the CSV and resend.

Thanks — looking to avoid bumping with ACME and ensure smooth handoff.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Operations Manager, Aurum Events
[Attachment: dock_map_v3.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)]
[Attachment: sidecar_loadlist_v2.csv (CSV, 24KB)]

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Aurum Events <ops@aurumevents.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: SoundRentals Ltd. <scheduling@soundrentals.co>, ACME Sponsorships <sponsorships@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Site sharing request: dock sidecar access + ambient audio note

Thanks Lena — looping in logistics and design. Quick responses below:

- Sidecar sharing: acceptable as long as we have a 30-minute buffer for staged transfer (i.e., Redwood unloads into sidecar; ACME then uses the space). Can we get a shared slot of 2:00–2:30pm and 3:30–4:00pm reserved? If venue can block those windows that would help.
- Ambient audio: we plan short demonstration audio (two 30s clips at booth demo cadence). We will stay below 70dB at the neighbor line. We’re happy to sign the venue's audio permit, but need to review the permit draft before submission.

Action items for our side:
1) Marissa — confirm final crate manifest & confirm helpers for the 2pm slot (can you update sidecar_loadlist_v2.csv?).
2) Soojin — confirm the demo audio files and send the permit language you prefer to sign.
3) Naomi — can you check whether we can bring an extra 4ft ramp for the sidecar? Venue sometimes requires ramps to be pre-approved.

I’ll tentatively accept the sidecar share subject to the above. Please keep me posted.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Field Ops, Redwood Inference
[Signature: Karthik Iyer | Redwood Inference]

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Aurum Events <ops@aurumevents.com>, soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Dec 2026 16:20:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Site sharing request: dock sidecar access + ambient audio note

Forwarding with updates — attaching revised manifest and an extra column for transfer windows.

Marissa here: updated sidecar_loadlist_v3.csv attached (renamed from v2). Key notes:
- We’ve consolidated 3 small crates into one flight case (reduces total trips).
- Marked which items need dolly vs. ramp.
- Added a "handoff" owner column so ACME knows who to meet at 2:30pm.

Sooj — I also included the demo audio filenames in the manifest notes (two clips, 30s each). If venue needs exact tracks, I can attach MP3s to the permit packet.

Aurum — we can do the 2:00–2:30pm primary unload and hold 3:30–4:00pm as buffer. Can you confirm the 30-minute buffer will be enforced on your scheduling side? Also tagging SoundRentals — will you be the point to verify audio decibel at neighbor line on load day?

Attachments: sidecar_loadlist_v3.csv (attached as revised manifest)

Thanks — Marissa
Sr. Production Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: sidecar_loadlist_v3.csv (CSV, 28KB)]

From: Aurum Events <ops@aurumevents.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: SoundRentals Ltd. <scheduling@soundrentals.co>, ACME Sponsorships <sponsorships@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Dec 2026 14:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Site sharing request: dock sidecar access + ambient audio note

All good — confirming the requested windows are reserved and the sidecar will be shared with the buffer windows enforced by staff. We’ve updated the dock schedule and attached the venue audio permit draft (ambient-audio-permit-draft.docx).

SoundRentals confirms they will be on-site to spot-check decibels during your demo windows and will provide a certificate if required. ACME has been notified about the handoff owner.

Next steps:
- Karthik / Marissa: please sign the permit and return by end of week (we’ll accept a scanned signature).
- Soojin: send the MP3 files (two tracks) so we can attach to the permit.
- Aurum: we’ll submit to venue once we have signed permit + audio files.

Thanks — appreciate the quick coordination.

— Lena Ortiz
Operations Manager, Aurum Events
[Attachment: ambient-audio-permit-draft.docx (DOCX, 45KB)]
